svg.title: Unitless 1 to 100 flag drawing and its squared area ratio
svg.desc: A first-party unpatterned flag-like rectangle measures 20 by 12 meters in reality. On a unitless 1 to 100 drawing, 2000 actual centimeters by 1200 actual centimeters become 20 drawing centimeters by 12 drawing centimeters. The diagram uses 12 pixels for one drawing centimeter and has width 240 pixels and height 144 pixels. Its drawing area is 240 square centimeters; the actual area is 240 square meters or 2400000 square centimeters. After expressing units consistently the area factor is 10000, which is the square of the length scale factor 100.
svg.text: Actual 20 m × 12 m; scaled drawing 20 cm × 12 cm
Area comparison only after using the same square-centimeter units.
